digest.component_or_area: rebar doctor command — lock health auditing
propositions: rebar doctor lacks diagnostic surface for held or orphaned write locks; operators cannot determine lock holder identity or process liveness without manual filesystem inspection

Four lock legs (two fcntl, one mkdir, one O_EXCL) must be reported with held/free/absent state, and the mkdir leg must expose owner stamp fields (host/ns/pid/start), holder liveness (same-host only), and hold age
Staleness determination must delegate exclusively to the existing lock_owner._mkdir_lock_is_stale function; no independent age threshold or pid probe may decide staleness in the new doctor module
A stale-lock finding (dead holder or fcntl leg held by non-existent pid) must join doctor's findings list, trigger exit code 1, but a held lock with live holder must remain INFO and keep exit 0
Doctor must be read-only: no lock reclamation, deletion, or mutation; --repair must never touch lock state
JSON output schema and docs must describe the new locks and lock_findings keys
